name: Health Care Immersion Summer Volunteer Program (Lenox Hill Hospital)
org: Northwell Health, Lenox Hill Hospital and its Auxiliary
what_you_do: A summer program for high school students. You volunteer in non-clinical roles around the hospital and see how a hospital runs and how patient care works.
who_can_apply: High school students interested in health care who can attend the full month. The page wants motivated, mature students with volunteer experience. Ten students are accepted.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. No cost is listed.
duration: At least 100 hours in July, at least four days a week (Monday to Thursday) from 9 AM to 3 PM. No vacation during that time.
deadline_text: The page still shows the 2025 notice: applications closed and the deadline was Jan 31, 2025. No 2026 or 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Watch the Lenox Hill volunteer page for the next call for forms. If you have a question, write to the Manhattan campus volunteer team. The email is manhattancampusvolunteers@northwell.edu.
notes: The page is out of date, so check with the volunteer team to see if there is a 2027 program. The regular junior volunteer program has different rules and needs working papers.
